base.artifact: any image, under a fault-injecting transport

evaluation: 0 − 1 underflows. No byte mutation of an image can produce it; it needs a device model that reports inconsistent positions.

expected.permitting_text: Section 12.2 calls a zero-block file 'structural damage' without naming an error; Section 15's TapeIo covers a 'transport/medium failure' and FilemarkMapReconstruct a walk that 'could not produce a valid map'.

hostile_source: device-reported positions only; no tape byte feeds the formula

mutation.name: post-space position
mutation.position: device report after spacing to the next filemark
mutation.value: equal to the file's start position (delta 0)

note: Listed among the formulas with no hostile tape-byte input.
pin_reason: Section 2.4 governs 'values read from tape'; whether device-reported positions are included is unstated, and no error is named.
quotes: measure the file's length by filemark spacing (space to the next filemark; the file's block count is the position delta minus one); a zero-block file or a missing trailing filemark is structural damage
